name: Oppresseur de Mars
description: Artilleur orbital bombardant les fortifications ennemies depuis les stations en orbite martienne.

subject.archetype: Oppresseur de Mars — Hégémonie martienne Uncommon class reseau

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy combat armor with thick crimson red plating showing battle scars and scorch marks, reinforced shoulder guards with dented imperial insignia, tactical undersuit at joints, magnetic combat boots locked to metal deck
loadout.arsenal: Standard-issue heavy plasma rifle with imperial engravings, combat chainsword with serrated edge, tactical grenade bandolier across chest, targeting visor HUD displaying red lock-on data The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's growing ability targeting adjacent_enemy, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Predatory lunge forward with hand extended like claw toward enemy with focused targeted red energy tendrils erupting from fingertips burrowing into enemy to siphon their strength
attitude.emotion: Battle-tested confidence — knowing skills will carry through the engagement

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Crimson Red
palette_names.role: primary_accent — armor plating and blood mist in the air

palette_names.name: Gunmetal Black
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — structural elements and deepest shadows

palette_names.name: Blinding White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — muzzle flash and explosive ignition

color_and_light.lighting_setup: oxidized copper frame with faction insignia embossed on each corner, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Slightly low angle waist-up shot with environmental action visible in background, motion blur on debris and effects

scenography.setting: Planetary assault battlefield with artillery detonating sending massive dust columns skyward, advancing infantry silhouettes through smoke, orbital dropships descending under anti-aircraft fire, trenches littered with spent casings
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Visible power drain with red tendrils burrowing into enemy and flowing stolen energy back to caster, enemy position visibly weakening and dimming as power is stolen and converted, Ground between caster and enemy withering as parasitic energy transfer corrupts everything in path, siphoned energy creating visible trail of corruption on return to caster, Artillery shells exploding in background sending up massive geysers of red dust, tracer rounds streaking across sky, crimson smoke grenades billowing, shrapnel flying past camera, ground cracking from impact tremors
